related_questions.question: How much does a respiratory therapist make in Oregon?

text_blocks.snippet: In Oregon, a respiratory therapist's salary typically ranges from $66,600 to $142,733 annually, with an average of $95,066, according to ZipRecruiter. The specific salary can vary based on experience, location, and employer.

list.title: Hourly Rate:

list.title: Factors Affecting Salary:

related_questions.question: How to verify respiratory therapist license in Texas?

text_blocks.snippet: To verify a Respiratory Care Practitioner (RCP) license in Texas, you can use the online search tool provided by the Texas Medical Board (TMB). The TMB regulates RCPs in Texas. You can access the search tool through the "Look up a License" link on the TMB website. The search results will display the license status (active, inactive, etc.), issue and expiration dates, and any disciplinary history.

list.snippet: Access the TMB website: Navigate to the Texas Medical Board website.
Locate the "Look up a License" tool: Find the link or button labeled "Look up a License" on the homepage.
Enter the licensee's information: You can search using the licensee's name, license number, or other relevant information.
Review the results: The search results will display the license status, issue and expiration dates, and any disciplinary actions associated with the license.

text_blocks.snippet: Note: The information available through the online search is considered primary source verification. For more detailed information, including the licensee's address of record, you may need to submit a Public Information Act request, according to the TMB.
